set.body:
Outcome

Recast one-shot readouts and fit-derived evidence directly inside the unified mvpa module.

Acceptance

- fMRI series and design produce Observations or PartitionedRelations directly.
- Trial readout, residual moments, estimability, and temporal preparation retain typed receipts.
- Operator-native kernels remain intact.
- The mvpa-fit artifact, bridge vocabulary, and duplicate result façade are deleted.
set.title: P6.1: absorb mvpa-fit as direct fMRI observation and relation construction
